[[Blast (enchantment)|Holy Blast 4]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Blast (enchantment)|Holy Blast 4]]:''' This weapon sings of virtue, dealing 4d6 Good damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Good damage on a critical hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned.
Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
